fields.name: Timer
fields.evidence: Toolkit ecl::TurnOrderSystem::UpdateActiveTurns (EoCClient.dll+0x913FF0) walks the components with stride 0xC: when +4 is 0 it sets +0 to an RPGStats ExtraData value (FixedString global DAT_181a170d0, default 1.0) and sets +4 = 1; otherwise it subtracts GameTime+8 (frame delta) from +0 each update and, when it reaches <= 0, writes 0 here, sets +8 = 1 and calls FUN_180907360 (turn end handling). Creator bg3.exe+0x1951F50 writes 0. Live 0. A countdown in seconds.

fields.name: TimerStarted
fields.evidence: Same function: set to 1 when Timer is loaded from ExtraData or expires; cleared to 0 when the entity no longer qualifies (end of the loop body). Creator writes 0; live 0.

fields.name: field_8
fields.evidence: UpdateActiveTurns sets it to 1 when the countdown expires, or (when a turn-participant flag pcVar19[2] is set and it was 0) sets it to 1 and adds a component through the command buffer; cleared to 0 when pcVar19[2] == 0, pcVar19[6] != 0 and pcVar19[3] == 0. Looks like 'turn end requested/handled'. Creator writes 0 (16-bit store with +9); live 0.

fields.name: field_9
fields.evidence: Zeroed by the creator's 16-bit store at +8; no reader seen.

fields.name: _PadA
fields.evidence: Not written by the creator (live 0xFFFF = garbage); size 12 with no 8-byte member means 4-byte alignment.

open_questions: Name of the ExtraData key that seeds Timer (FixedString DAT_181a170d0 in EoCClient.dll) - probably a turn-time-limit setting.
Exact meaning of field_8 (turn end requested?) and whether field_9 is used.
